targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::bigint
        AS "USER_TOTAL",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE is_active = TRUE
    )::bigint
        AS "USER_ACTIVE",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            (
                created_at
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'
            )::date
            =
            (
                NOW()
                AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'
            )::date
    )::bigint
        AS "USER_TODAY",

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
        THEN 0

        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0
            * COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE is_active = TRUE
            )
            /
            COUNT(*),
            1
        )
    END
        AS "USER_ACTIVE_RATE"

FROM accounts_user

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_REQUESTS",

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                AND status IN (
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR',
                    'TIMEOUT',
                    'CANCELLED'
                )
        ) = 0
        THEN NULL

        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0
            *
            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE
                    $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                    AND status = 'COMPLETED'
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                COUNT(*) FILTER (
                    WHERE
                        $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                        AND status IN (
                            'COMPLETED',
                            'FAILED',
                            'ERROR',
                            'TIMEOUT',
                            'CANCELLED'
                        )
                ),
                0
            ),
            1
        )
    END
        AS "AI_SUCCESS_RATE",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status = 'COMPLETED'
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_COMPLETED",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            $__timeFilter(requested_at)
            AND status IN (
                'FAILED',
                'ERROR',
                'TIMEOUT',
                'CANCELLED'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "AI_FAILED"

FROM ai_aianalysis

WITH audit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND COALESCE(
                    outcome,
                    'UNKNOWN'
                ) NOT IN (
                    'SUCCESS',
                    'SUCCEEDED',
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'OK'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS bad,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                occurred_at
                >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

                AND COALESCE(
                    outcome,
                    'UNKNOWN'
                ) NOT IN (
                    'SUCCESS',
                    'SUCCEEDED',
                    'COMPLETED',
                    'OK'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS recent,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND outcome IN (
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS critical,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
                AND outcome = 'WARNING'
        )::bigint
            AS warning

    FROM audit_auditlog
),

ai_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE
                $__timeFilter(requested_at)
                AND status IN (
                    'FAILED',
                    'ERROR',
                    'TIMEOUT',
                    'CANCELLED'
                )
        )::bigint
            AS bad

    FROM ai_aianalysis
)

SELECT
    (
        audit_stats.bad
        + ai_stats.bad
    )::bigint
        AS "INCIDENT_TOTAL",

    audit_stats.recent
        AS "INCIDENT_1H",

    (
        audit_stats.critical
        + ai_stats.bad
    )::bigint
        AS "CRITICAL",

    audit_stats.warning
        AS "WARNING"

FROM audit_stats
CROSS JOIN ai_stats

panels.title: 전체 서비스 사용량 · 실시간
panels.description: API 요청, AI 분석 요청, Async 이벤트의 실제 발생 추이.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(
        requested_at,
        '5m'
    ),

    COUNT(*)::double precision
        AS "AI 요청"

FROM ai_aianalysis

WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(
        created_at,
        '5m'
    ),

    COUNT(*)::double precision
        AS "Async 이벤트"

FROM common_outboxevent

WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    occurred_at AS "시간",
    outcome AS "구분",
    COALESCE(
        reason,
        action
    ) AS "메시지"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

    AND COALESCE(
        outcome,
        'UNKNOWN'
    ) NOT IN (
        'SUCCESS',
        'SUCCEEDED',
        'COMPLETED',
        'OK'
    )

ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    occurred_at AS "일시",

    COALESCE(
        actor_login_id,
        'SYSTEM'
    ) AS "사용자",

    action AS "작업 내용",

    outcome AS "결과"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

LIMIT 10

panels.title: 전체 사용자 · 상세
panels.description: 실제 accounts_user / roles 기준 사용자 현황.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    u.created_at
        AS "생성 시각",

    u.login_id
        AS "Login ID",

    u.name
        AS "사용자",

    COALESCE(
        r.code,
        '-'
    )
        AS "Role",

    CASE
        WHEN u.is_active
        THEN 'ACTIVE'
        ELSE 'INACTIVE'
    END
        AS "상태"

FROM accounts_user u

LEFT JOIN roles r
    ON r.id = u.role_id

ORDER BY u.created_at DESC

LIMIT 300

SELECT
    created_at
        AS "생성 시각",

    event_type
        AS "이벤트",

    aggregate_type
        AS "대상 유형",

    aggregate_id
        AS "대상 ID",

    status
        AS "상태",

    retry_count
        AS "재시도",

    published_at
        AS "발행 시각",

    COALESCE(
        payload ->> 'request_id',
        '-'
    )
        AS request_id

FROM common_outboxevent

WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

ORDER BY created_at DESC

LIMIT 300

SELECT
    requested_at
        AS "요청 시각",

    id::text
        AS "Analysis ID",

    analysis_type
        AS "분석 유형",

    status
        AS "상태",

    COALESCE(
        failure_code,
        '-'
    )
        AS "오류 코드",

    COALESCE(
        trace_id::text,
        '-'
    )
        AS request_id,

    CASE
        WHEN trace_id IS NULL
        THEN '-'

        ELSE
            'ERR-'
            ||
            UPPER(
                SUBSTRING(
                    REPLACE(
                        trace_id::text,
                        '-',
                        ''
                    )
                    FROM 1 FOR 16
                )
            )
    END
        AS "오류 참조번호"

FROM ai_aianalysis

WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

ORDER BY requested_at DESC

LIMIT 300

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        occurred_at
            AS "시간",

        'Audit'::text
            AS "유형",

        source_service
            AS "서비스",

        action
            AS "이벤트",

        outcome
            AS "상태",

        COALESCE(
            reason,
            '-'
        )
            AS "원인",

        COALESCE(
            request_id::text,
            '-'
        )
            AS request_id,

        CASE
            WHEN request_id IS NULL
            THEN '-'

            ELSE
                'ERR-'
                ||
                UPPER(
                    SUBSTRING(
                        REPLACE(
                            request_id::text,
                            '-',
                            ''
                        )
                        FROM 1 FOR 16
                    )
                )
        END
            AS "오류 참조번호"

    FROM audit_auditlog

    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

        AND COALESCE(
            outcome,
            'UNKNOWN'
        ) NOT IN (
            'SUCCESS',
            'SUCCEEDED',
            'COMPLETED',
            'OK'
        )


    UNION ALL


    SELECT
        requested_at
            AS "시간",

        'AI'::text
            AS "유형",

        'AI Inference'::text
            AS "서비스",

        analysis_type
            AS "이벤트",

        status
            AS "상태",

        COALESCE(
            failure_code,
            '-'
        )
            AS "원인",

        COALESCE(
            trace_id::text,
            '-'
        )
            AS request_id,

        CASE
            WHEN trace_id IS NULL
            THEN '-'

            ELSE
                'ERR-'
                ||
                UPPER(
                    SUBSTRING(
                        REPLACE(
                            trace_id::text,
                            '-',
                            ''
                        )
                        FROM 1 FOR 16
                    )
                )
        END
            AS "오류 참조번호"

    FROM ai_aianalysis

    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(requested_at)

        AND status IN (
            'FAILED',
            'ERROR',
            'TIMEOUT',
            'CANCELLED'
        )
) x

ORDER BY "시간" DESC

LIMIT 300
